summary: Describes a simpler way for a SIP phone to turn an Alert-Info URN into a signal such as a ringtone. The alert URN namespace tells the phone the characteristics of a call, and the phone must pick a matching sound or behavior. This memo offers an easier method than the earlier one.

eli5.summary: A phone gets a note saying what kind of call this is, like urgent or doorbell. This explains an easier way to pick the right ring sound from that note.

questions: how phones pick ringtone from alert urn
